combos.name: VIDEO EXPERT — True Light / Spirit Dragon / Sifr Line
requires: Sage with Eyes of Blue + Maiden of White access + Blue-Eyes access + Primite setup
combos.result: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon + Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon + Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres + Primite Drillbeam + True Light + Blue-Eyes with Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon protection + follow-up. The demonstrated end position is presented as approximately 5–6 disruptions.
combos.sourceNote: Built from the user's uploaded video section 4:46–8:17. The video demonstrates the sequencing and final interaction package; some intermediate actions are hand/setup dependent, so this trainer labels the line as a reference route rather than claiming it is the only legal route from every opening hand.

steps.title: 1. Establish Spirit with Eyes of Blue
steps.action: Reach Spirit with Eyes of Blue using your Primite/Blue-Eyes starter sequence. In the demonstrated line, Spirit is already established before the True Light sequence begins.
steps.why: Spirit is the bridge that gives access to Mausoleum and the Blue-Eyes GY setup.

steps.title: 2. Resolve Spirit's search
steps.action: Use Spirit with Eyes of Blue to add Mausoleum of White when that search has not already been obtained.
steps.why: Mausoleum provides the additional Normal Summon and the GY-loading effect needed for the expert Synchro line.

steps.title: 3. Establish Sage + Maiden
steps.action: Normal Summon Sage with Eyes of Blue when the additional Normal Summon is available, then use Sage to access Maiden of White.
steps.why: Sage supplies the Level 1 tuner and Maiden becomes the True Light engine and later Synchro material.

steps.title: 4. Activate True Light first
steps.action: Place/activate True Light before continuing the rest of the Blue-Eyes extension.
steps.why: This ordering is a key teaching point from the video. True Light must be established before the following Blue-Eyes search/summon sequence so its once-per-turn resources are available at the correct point.

steps.title: 5. Special Summon Blue-Eyes with True Light
steps.action: Use True Light to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the hand or GY when the required Blue-Eyes resource is available.
steps.why: True Light converts the setup into a Level 8 Blue-Eyes body without spending another Normal Summon.

steps.title: 6. Resolve Maiden's return effect
steps.action: When the Blue-Eyes Special Summon satisfies Maiden of White's trigger, use Maiden to Special Summon herself from the GY when appropriate.
steps.why: Maiden gives you another Level 1 tuner and is a key material for the second Synchro Dragon.

steps.title: 7. Make Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon #1
steps.action: Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon using the available Blue-Eyes Level 8 monster and Sage with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Spirit Dragon is the first Level 9 Synchro and its tag-out effect is the route into the higher boss monsters.

steps.title: 8. Make the second Level 9 Synchro
steps.action: Use the remaining Blue-Eyes + Maiden resources to Synchro Summon the second Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon when the line permits.
steps.why: The two Level 9 Synchros are used as separate conversion points: one becomes Ultimate Spirit Dragon and the other becomes Crimson Dragon.

steps.title: 9. Convert Spirit Dragon into Ultimate Spirit
steps.action: Use a Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon's tag-out effect to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Ultimate Spirit Dragon provides a major on-board interaction/negate and is one of the core final-board pieces shown in the video.

steps.title: 10. Convert the other Spirit Dragon into Crimson Dragon
steps.action: Use the second Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon's tag-out effect to Special Summon Crimson Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Crimson Dragon is the bridge into Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon.

steps.title: 11. Crimson Dragon → Stardust Sifr
steps.action: Activate Crimson Dragon targeting Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon, then Special Summon Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Sifr adds the monster-effect negate/destruction interaction and protection layer highlighted in the video's final board.

steps.title: 12. Prepare the Primite interaction
steps.action: Keep Primite Lordly Lode / Primite Drillbeam online. If Lode has not already provided Drillbeam, resolve the Primite search at the correct point and keep a Normal Monster available when required.
steps.why: The video treats Drillbeam as a separate interaction from the Synchro bosses, increasing the number of disruptions without replacing the Blue-Eyes engine.

steps.title: 13. Use Lordly Lode for Blue-Eyes follow-up
steps.action: When the board state permits, activate Primite Lordly Lode declaring Blue-Eyes White Dragon to Special Summon Blue-Eyes from the GY.
steps.why: This creates another Blue-Eyes body, supports Primite conditions, and gives follow-up rather than ending with an empty resource pool.

steps.title: 14. Protect Blue-Eyes with Neo Ultimate
steps.action: Use Wishes for Eyes of Blue's GY effect when available to equip Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to a Blue-Eyes White Dragon.
steps.why: The demonstrated end position uses Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon as an Equip Spell to provide targeting protection while also converting Wishes into additional board value.

steps.title: 15. Establish Hieratic Seal
steps.action: Use the available Dragon bodies to Link Summon Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres when the line and Extra Deck resources permit.
steps.why: Hieratic Seal supplies the highlighted return-to-hand interaction and can turn its own tribute into another Dragon summon.

steps.title: 16. Keep True Light live
steps.action: Leave True Light active and preserve its once-per-turn Special Summon or Set effect for the opponent's turn when possible.
steps.why: True Light is part of the final resource loop rather than merely a combo starter.

steps.title: 17. Final expert board check
steps.action: Check that the board retains Ultimate Spirit Dragon, Stardust Sifr, Hieratic Seal where the route produced it, Primite Drillbeam interaction, True Light, and a protected/follow-up Blue-Eyes resource.
steps.why: The video's end position is about layered interaction: monster negate/destruction, an omni-negate, a return-to-hand effect, Primite interaction, and additional destruction/follow-up. The video presents this as approximately 5–6 disruptions.

steps.title: 18. Opponent-turn priorities
steps.action: Do not fire every interaction immediately. Use the appropriate effect for the opponent's threat: Hieratic Seal for a valuable face-up card, Sifr for a monster effect, Ultimate Spirit/Primite interaction for effects that must be negated, and True Light for follow-up when the timing is favorable.
steps.why: Expert play is not only reaching the board; it is sequencing the interruptions so one interaction does not unnecessarily overlap another.

combos.name: EXPERT — Ether Beryl + Sage Core Line
combos.result: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon + Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon + Primite Drillbeam + Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon protection + True Light/Wishes follow-up.
combos.sourceNote: Core no-interruption route. Use the video-reference line above when learning the specific sequencing shown in the supplied video.

steps.title: Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl and Set Primite Lordly Lode.
steps.why: Generate the Primite package before committing the Blue-Eyes Normal Summon.

steps.title: Search Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Primite Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: Bank the Primite interaction early.

steps.title: Link into Spirit
steps.action: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Ether Beryl and search Mausoleum of White.
steps.why: Convert the Primite starter into Blue-Eyes engine access.

steps.title: Activate Mausoleum
steps.action: Activate Mausoleum of White and use its additional Normal Summon for Sage.
steps.why: This bypasses the Normal Summon already spent on Ether Beryl.

steps.title: Sage → Maiden
steps.action: Normal Summon Sage and add Maiden of White.
steps.why: Maiden establishes True Light and becomes later Synchro material.

steps.title: Maiden → True Light
steps.action: Send Maiden as required to place True Light face-up.
steps.why: Establish True Light before continuing the high-value extension.

steps.title: Mausoleum loads Blue-Eyes
steps.action: Target Spirit with Mausoleum and send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from Deck to GY.
steps.why: Load the Normal Monster so Spirit can Special Summon it.

steps.title: Spirit → Blue-Eyes
steps.action: Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue to Special Summon Blue-Eyes from the GY.
steps.why: Create the Level 8 body for the first Synchro.

steps.title: Maiden returns
steps.action: Special Summon Maiden from the GY after Blue-Eyes is Special Summoned.
steps.why: Recover the Level 1 tuner for the next Synchro.

steps.title: First Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon using Blue-Eyes + Sage.
steps.why: Start the boss conversion sequence.

steps.title: Second Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Use the second Blue-Eyes + Maiden route to make another Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon.
steps.why: The second Level 9 body becomes Crimson Dragon.

steps.title: Ultimate Spirit + Crimson → Sifr
steps.action: Tag the two Spirit Dragons into Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon and Crimson Dragon, then use Crimson to summon Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon.
steps.why: Layer the major boss interactions.

steps.title: Finish Primite resources
steps.action: Use Lordly Lode/Drillbeam and True Light/Wishes for the appropriate follow-up based on the cards remaining in hand.
steps.why: Preserve interaction and follow-up instead of overextending.
